Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer / Web Application Engineer
for an initial 3–6 month contract engagement focused on the WCAG 2.1 Level AA remediation of two existing public-facing web applications
built on the Microsoft ASP.NET platform.
The initial phase of the project requires working within an established legacy application stack to identify, remediate, test, and document accessibility issues while preserving existing application functionality and business workflows.
Following successful completion of the accessibility phase, this position has the potential to extend into a 12–24 month application modernization and re-engineering project
. The second phase will involve redesigning and rebuilding the existing applications using the current Microsoft .NET / ASP.NET Core web application stack.
This is an excellent opportunity for a developer who is comfortable working in both worlds: maintaining and improving an established production system today while helping architect its replacement for tomorrow.

Phase 1 – WCAG 2.1 Level AA Remediation

The initial 3–6 month engagement will focus primarily on accessibility remediation of two production, public-facing web applications.
Responsibilities will include:
Review existing ASP.NET web applications for WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance issues.
Remediate accessibility issues throughout the user interface while minimizing changes to existing business functionality.
Correct HTML structure, forms, labels, navigation, tables, dialogs, validation messages, and interactive controls.
Implement proper ARIA attributes and accessible markup where appropriate.
Improve keyboard navigation, tab order, focus management, and visible focus behavior.
Address color contrast, responsive layout, text scaling, and other accessibility requirements.
Improve compatibility with screen readers and assistive technologies.
Remediate accessibility issues involving third-party UI components, including Kendo UI.
Work with existing JavaScript and AngularJS components without unnecessarily destabilizing the production application.
Perform regression testing to ensure accessibility changes do not impact existing functionality.
Assist with accessibility testing using automated and manual testing techniques.
Document remediation changes, technical limitations, and any remaining accessibility exceptions.
Work directly with the existing development team to troubleshoot and resolve application issues.

Existing Technology Stack

Candidates should have hands-on experience with several of the following technologies:
Microsoft ASP.NET / .NET Framework 4.5+
C#
ASP.NET MVC
HTML5
CSS / CSS3
JavaScript
jQuery
AngularJS
Telerik / Kendo UI
Bootstrap 3.x
AJAX
REST / Web APIs
Microsoft Visual Studio
Git or equivalent source-control systems

Experience maintaining and modifying legacy production ASP.NET applications
is particularly important.
Accessibility Experience

Strong knowledge of web accessibility is highly desirable, including experience with:
WCAG 2.1 Level AA
WAI-ARIA
Semantic HTML
Keyboard-only navigation
Focus management
Accessible forms and validation
Screen-reader compatibility
Color contrast requirements
Responsive and zoom-compatible interfaces
Accessibility testing tools such as Axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, Accessibility Insights, or similar tools

Experience performing accessibility remediation on complex data-driven web applications
, rather than only static websites, is strongly preferred.
Phase 2 – Application Modernization

Candidates who successfully complete the initial remediation project may be offered an additional 12–24 month contract
to participate in the complete re-engineering of the two applications.
The modernization effort is expected to include:
Re-engineering legacy ASP.NET applications onto the current Microsoft .NET LTS platform.
Development using modern ASP.NET Core architecture.
Migration of legacy business logic and application functionality.
Modernization of the front-end architecture and user experience.
Replacement of legacy AngularJS and Bootstrap components with a modern supported front-end framework and component architecture.
Development of RESTful APIs and service-oriented application components.
Modern authentication and authorization.
Integration with Microsoft Azure services where appropriate.
Improved application security, maintainability, performance, scalability, and deployment.
Accessibility designed into the new application architecture rather than added afterward.
Preservation and validation of existing business rules during migration.
Participation in technical design, architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.

The modernization project will essentially move the applications from a legacy architecture that has accumulated years of dependencies into a modern, maintainable platform designed for the next generation of the system.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional software development experience preferred.
Strong C# and Microsoft ASP.NET development experience.
Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills.
Experience troubleshooting and modifying existing production web applications.
Understanding of browser developer tools and front-end debugging.
Ability to work within an existing codebase before proposing major architectural changes.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

is a hands-on technical contributor on a team that collectively owns our automated test framework for embedded software running on the precision field computer platform. Train team members on utilization of test equipment and procedures.
Keep abreast of new developments in the fields of engineering design, methods, and applications.
May assist with the request for quote process, as related to needs for the testing function.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or technical field.
3+ years of engineering experience in Software Test Automation for Embedded systems.
Strong Proficiency in Python with 3+ years of experience for test case development and automation.
Hands-on Experience with CAN tools similar to CANoe/CANalyzer by Vector.
Experience with Qt/QML/Squish or equivalent GUI automation tools.
Familiarity with virtualization/emulation environments.
Understanding of Network Protocols and standards such as but not limited to: ISO11783 (ISOBUS), J1939
Experience with git and supporting CI/CD tools.

Experience with Linux and Build System/project Frameworks such as Yocto.
Background in Agricutural Embedded Systems.
Strong Communication and Problem-Solving skills.
Demonstrated use of Root-Cause Analysis tools (Five Whys, Ishikawa Diagrams, Fault-Tree, etc.)
